opening.argument: The presentation offers a flash-loan arbitrage bot as a step-by-step way to earn BNB, then directs viewers to connect a MetaMask wallet, deploy the contract, and send BNB to it before running transactions. It expressly instructs viewers to “Send cash money over to the contract address to run it” and presents the workflow as producing an amount just made. Alongside those required fund transfers and operational steps, it claims that the specified retry configuration should work 100%, pairing a financial-return promise with instructions to transfer funds and execute the contract.
